label: GO step, early in the episode (first ~30-40 trials)
explanation: Update-gate unit that is active only at the GO step (never D1 or D2), and only in the early part of an episode: GO active rate is about 18% for trials 0-29, 5% for 30-39, 1% for 40-49 and zero from trial 50 on (never on trial 0). Nearly all activation (96%) falls where the value head reads 7.73-8.10, and the policy is confident (|choice| large, either action). Within the early GO steps the unit fires on only about half, so precision is limited (dev P 0.48, R 0.87, mass recall 0.90). Magnitude: 86% of mass follows a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward=1). In the example windows it is largest on the first rewarded GO after an unrewarded trial and decays over a run of rewarded repeats (about 0.99, 0.81, 0.48, 0.29); I did not score this decay directly. A predicate requiring reward on the previous or second-previous trial raised mass recall slightly but not F1. It does not depend on the transition type, stay/switch, or which state is good. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables (phase and episode time).
